name: Goton - Crane Game Simulator
summary:
A VR simulator that recreates the arcade claw machine down to the smallest detail.

The arm flexes, the claw grips with realistic friction, and boxes slide and tumble the way they do in a real cabinet. Real-world techniques work here: nudge prizes toward the chute, tip boxes over the edge, slip the claw into gaps.

- Take on more than 100 quests with a wide range of prizes and difficulties
- Display everything you win in your collection
- Switch viewpoints and height freely - comfortable to play seated or s
